guide critical technical decisions, and establish practices that turn research and prototypes into reliable operational capabilities * Own integrated planning and controls—scope, schedule, budget, milestones, resourcing, and governance—delivering clear, actionable status reporting and documented decisions * Apply agile practices to support iterative software delivery, data science experimentation, and development cycles * Collaborate with Technical Leads, Architects, Principal Investigators, Data Scientists, and SMEs to drive execution, resolve blockers, and align technical decisions with program objectives * Maintain project artifacts in Jira/Confluence (backlogs, roadmaps, decision logs, action items, dependency tracking) * Identify and mitigate risks and issues across scope, technical execution, data quality, model performance, ML\-Ops readiness, security/compliance, and deployment * Serve as primary stakeholder interface, translating mission objectives into executable plans and managing expectations on progress, risks, and tradeoffs **This position is based in Richland, WA or Seattle, WA and requires an onsite presence.** Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications:* BS/BA and 11\+ years of relevant project management experience \-OR\- * MS/MA or higher and 9\+ years of relevant project management experience * Experience managing software engineering, analytics, AI/ML, or data science projects in technically complex environments, including experimentation, validation, deployment, and operationalization Preferred Qualifications:* Degree in computer science, data science, information technology, engineering, or a related technical field. * Experience with National Security or federal government projects. * Demonstrated success with cross\-functional teams (software engineers, data scientists, researchers, SMEs). * Experienced in agile delivery methodologies and project management tools, including Jira and Confluence. * Demonstrated streng gram. About PNNL: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) is a world\-class research institution powered by a highly educated, diverse workforce committed to the values of Integrity, Creativity, Collaboration, Impact, and Courage. Every year, scores of dynamic, driven people come to PNNL to work with renowned researchers on meaningful science, innovations and outcomes for the U.S. Department of Energy and other sponsors; here is your chance to be one of them! At PNNL, you will find an exciting research environment and excellent benefits including health insurance, and flexible work schedules. PNNL is located in eastern Washington State—the dry side of Washington known for its stellar outdoor recreation and affordable cost of living. The Lab’s campus is only a 45\-minute flight (or \~3 hour drive) from Seattle or Portland, and is serviced by the convenient PSC airport, connected to 8 major hubs. Commitment to Excellence and Equal Employment Opportunity: Our laboratory is committed to fostering a work environment where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect while solving critical challenges in fundamental sciences, national security, and energy resiliency. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. PNNL considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), protected veteran status, and any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local laws. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures and in employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, contact us at careers@pnnl.gov. Drug Free Workplace: PNNL is committed to a drug\-free workplace supported by Workplace Substance Abuse Program (WSAP) and complies with federal laws prohibiting the possession and use of illegal drugs. If you are offered employment at PNNL, you must pass a drug test prior to commencing employment. PNNL complies with federal law regarding illegal drug use. Under federal law, marijuana remains an illegal drug. If you test positive for any illegal controlled substance, including marijuana, your offer of employment will be withdrawn. HSPD\-12 PIV Credential Requirement: As a national laboratory, PNNL is responsible for adhering to the Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD\-12\) and Department of Energy (DOE) Order 473\.1A, which require new employees to obtain and maintain a HSPD\-12 Personal Identify Verification (PIV) Credential. To obtain this credential, new employees must successfully complete the applicable tier of federal background investigation post hire and receive a favorable federal adjudication. The tier of federal background investigation will be determined by job duties and national security or public trust responsibilities associated with the job. All tiers of investigation include a declaration of illegal drug activities, including use, supply, possession, or manufacture within the last 1 to 7 years (depending on the applicable tier of investigation). Illegal drug activities include marijuana and cannabis derivatives, which are still considered illegal under federal law, regardless of state laws. For foreign national candidates: If you have not resided in the U.S. for three consecutive years, you are not eligible for the PIV credential and instead will need to obtain a favorable Local Site Specific Only (LSSO) Federal risk determination to maintain employment. Once you meet the three\-year residency requirement thereafter, you will be required to obtain a PIV credential to maintain employment. The tier of federal background investigation required to obtain the PIV credential will be determined by job duties at the time you become eligible for the PIV credential.

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer, Computer Vision & VLMs
jobs.description: Palona is building AI for the physical world, starting with restaurants. Understanding a busy restaurant means making sense of people, objects, activities, and events as they change over time, despite occlusion, changing lighting, varied camera views, and incomplete information. We are looking for an AI Research Engineer with a strong research background in computer vision and vision\-language models (VLMs) to develop the visual intelligence behind Palona’s products. You will work on image and video understanding, spatiotemporal reasoning, and multimodal models that connect visual observations to useful insights and actions in real restaurant environments. This role combines research depth with ownership of working systems. You will formulate research questions, build datasets, train and evaluate models, and partner with product and engineering to bring successful approaches into production. Researchers and engineers from autonomous driving, robotics, embodied AI, and related perception fields are especially encouraged to apply. What you’ll own* Develop computer vision and VLM approaches for scene understanding, object detection and tracking, activity recognition, and understanding events across video. * Adapt, fine\-tune, and evaluate vision and vision\-language models for visual grounding, temporal reasoning, and structured prediction grounded in observable evidence. * Design training and adaptation strategies, including supervised fine\-tuning, representation learning, distillation, and domain adaptation, based on measurable product needs. * Build representative image and video datasets, annotation workflows, and evaluation sets that capture difficult edge cases while protecting sensitive data. * Create rigorous experiments and benchmarks that measure perception quality, temporal consistency, hallucinations, robustness, latency, and cost across locations and operating conditions. * Diagnose failures caused by occlusion, lighting changes, camera placement, rare events, and domain shift; use those findings to improve data and models. * Partner with infrastructure and product engineers to deploy efficient inference pipelines, with monitoring, quality gates, staged rollouts, and rollback paths. * Translate advances in computer vision, VLMs, and embodied AI into practical product capabilities, and communicate the evidence and tradeoffs behind your decisions. * Raise research and engineering standards through reproducible experiments, thoughtful reviews, and clear documentation. **Requirements** * 3\+ years of research or applied development experience in computer vision, multimodal learning, or a closely related field; relevant graduate research counts toward this experience. * A demonstrated research track record in computer vision or vision\-language modeling, through publications, substantial research projects, open\-source contributions, or research delivered in industry. * Strong foundations in deep learning, visual representation learning, and experimental design, with depth in areas such as video understanding, detection and tracking, visual grounding, or multimodal reasoning. * Hands\-on experience training, fine\-tuning, or adapting computer vision models, and developing or evaluating VLMs beyond basic API integration. * Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or an equivalent deep learning framework, along with modern training and evaluation tooling. * Experience building datasets, designing reliable evaluations, analyzing model failures, and using ablations to understand what drives improvements. * Strong software engineering judgment and the ability to turn research code into reproducible, tested systems that other engineers can use. * Ability to connect modeling choices to product constraints including latency, cost, privacy, reliability, and user experience. * Comfort working through ambiguity and collaborating across research, engineering, and product. Especially relevant experience* A PhD or research\-focused master’s degree in computer vision, machine learning, robotics, or a related field, or equivalent research experience. * Industry research or engineering experience in autonomous driving, robotics, embodied AI, or other applications of perception in the physical world. * Publications at venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, CoRL, ICRA, or RSS. * Experience with monocular video perception, spatial understanding, long\-video reasoning, or learning from limited and noisy labels. * Experience shipping vision models under real\-time constraints, including model compression, distillation, quantization, or inference optimization. When applying, please include links to relevant publications, research projects, or code, and briefly describe your own contribution. **Benefits** * **Competitive salary and stock option plan.** * **Company\-sponsored green card applications for strong candidates** hired into U.S.\-based roles, subject to eligibility. * Medical, dental, vision, and retirement benefits as applicable. * Family leave and short\-term and long\-term disability benefits as applicable. * Paid time off and company holidays. * Learning and development support.

jobs.title: Backend Systems Engineer (Python/C++)

jobs.title: Lead Data Platform Engineer - Snowflake & dbt Cloud
jobs.description: Are you looking for a forward focus environment where you are continually challenged, and the atmosphere is affirming? Do you want to be a part of a team where you are often out of your comfort zone, but you wake up excited to go to work each day? How about a place where people are growing because they desire change and growth is modeled and expected? **WHO WE ARE:** Premier Trailer Leasing is a '**USA Today Top Workplace**' and one of the largest trailer leasing and rental companies in the nation, specializing in long\-term leasing and short\-term rental services for over\-the\-road vans, flatbeds, refrigerated equipment and chassis with an inventory of 70,000 trailers and a growing network of locations across the United States. At Premier you will find an environment where you are seen, heard and valued. Join us and experience what it means to live a culture of C.A.R.E! **JOB SCOPE:** Premier Trailer Leasing is building its next\-generation Enterprise Data Platform to support its continued growth as part of a hybrid data modernization plan. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role for an experienced Snowflake builder. You will help design and implement a greenfield Snowflake environment, establish the engineering practices surrounding it, and deliver governed, production\-grade data products supporting reporting, operational integrations, APIs, and future AI workloads. We are looking for someone who has built and operated this kind of platform before, brings practical lessons from prior implementations, takes ownership, and constructively challenges technical assumptions. As the platform and team grow, you will establish the standards and patterns future data engineers will follow. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * **Greenfield Platform Build:** Partner with Data Leadership to design and implement a modern data platform using Snowflake, dbt Cloud, managed ingestion and CDC tooling, appropriate custom integrations, and GitHub\-based workflows. * **Engineering Standards \& Operating Model:** Establish repeatable practices for environments, Git workflows, modular development, testing, code review, CI/CD, deployment controls, rollback, documentation, monitoring, access, and production support. * **Data Architecture \& Modeling:** Build a layered architecture spanning raw ingestion, conformed enterprise models, and published marts or data products. Design canonical models that standardize core business entities, definitions, relationships, and rules. * **Ingestion \& CDC:** Design and operate resilient ingestion patterns for SQL Server, ERP, CRM, SaaS applications, REST APIs, files, and semi\-structured data using managed CDC and ingestion platforms alongside custom integrations where appropriate. * **Legacy Decoupling:** Work with Data Leadership and the SQL Server team to profile legacy sources, inventory dependencies, identify data\-quality risks, reconcile existing outputs, and migrate consumers from direct source\-system access to governed data products. * **Quality, Reliability \& Observability:** Establish automated testing, reconciliation, freshness monitoring, schema\-change controls, CDC\-lag monitoring, alerting, failure handling, retry and replay patterns, runbooks, and production support expectations. * **Security, Cost \& Performance:** Design Snowflake environments, roles, service accounts, access patterns, workload isolation, monitoring, and consumption controls that support least privilege, auditability, performance, and responsible cloud spend. * **Data Delivery:** Publish governed data products for Power BI, SSRS, Excel, HubSpot, Jira, internal and customer\-facing APIs, custom applications, and a DBA\-managed SQL Server serving layer for approved legacy and latency\-sensitive consumers. * **Technical Ownership \& Collaboration:** Serve as the technical lead for the platform, owning technical quality, production readiness, design patterns, documentation, and platform stability while collaborating with Data Leadership and the data team, as well as infrastructure, security, and application teams. **QUALIFICATIONS \& REQUIREMENTS:** * **Proven Greenfield Snowflake Experience:** 7\+ years of progressive data engineering or data platform experience, including substantial hands\-on responsibility for at least one production greenfield Snowflake implementation or major platform modernization into Snowflake. * **Deep Snowflake Experience:** Practical expertise with Snowflake architecture, warehouse and workload design, RBAC, security, cost governance, performance tuning, semi\-structured data, monitoring, and production operations. * **dbt Cloud Expertise:** Hands\-on experience establishing and operating dbt Cloud with GitHub for modular transformation development, testing, lineage, documentation, environment management, CI, and production deployment. * **Production Pipeline Ownership:** Experience designing and operating resilient ingestion, CDC, transformation, and delivery pipelines, including schema drift, freshness, reconciliation, failure recovery, retry, replay, and incident response. * **Data Modeling \& Quality:** Expertise designing conformed enterprise models, dimensional marts, and durable canonical data products supported by automated testing and data\-quality controls. * **Software Engineering Practices:** Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, Git and GitHub workflows, automated testing, code review, modular development, CI/CD, and controlled production releases. * **Security, Governance \& Cost Discipline:** Experience establishing practical access controls, environment separation, service\-account and secrets patterns, auditability, production\-change controls, and consumption monitoring. * **Pragmatic Technical Leadership:** A hands\-on builder who communicates tradeoffs clearly, challenges assumptions constructively, and takes ownership of reliability, maintainability, documentation, and production delivery. * **Location:** Must be based in, or willing to commute to, the Plano, TX office at least 3 days per week. **PREFERRRED EXPERIENCE:** * Experience migrating or decoupling consumers from legacy Microsoft SQL Server environments into Snowflake. * Experience with SQL Server CDC and near\-real\-time ingestion. * Experience with Dynamics GP, enterprise CRM systems, or similarly complex operational platforms. * Experience with Azure Blob Storage, semi\-structured documents, images, or other unstructured data. * Experience with reverse ETL, operational data delivery, customer\-facing data APIs, or application integrations. * Experience with Terraform or comparable infrastructure\-as\-code practices. * Experience mentoring engineers or helping establish a growing data engineering function. **TECH STACK:** * **Primary Platform:** Snowflake * **Transformation, Testing \& Lineage:** dbt Cloud * **Source Control \& CI/CD:** GitHub, GitHub Actions, dbt Cloud CI * **Ingestion \& CDC:** Managed ingestion platform, SQL Server CDC, REST APIs, files, and custom integrations * **Primary Sources:** SQL Server, Dynamics GP (ERP), CRM, SaaS applications, Azure Blob Storage, APIs, and semi\-structured data * **Consumers:** Power BI, SSRS, Excel, HubSpot, Jira, APIs, custom applications, SQL Server serving layers, and future AI and machine\-learning workloads

jobs.title: Integration Developer
jobs.description: Overview: The Princeton DMIA Integration team is seeking a skilled API Developer to join our team. In this role you will design, build, and maintain system\-to\-system integrations that connect our enterprise applications and enable seamless data exchange across the organization. You will serve as the primary integration engineer for our API platform. Designing a migration strategy from existing WSO2 to next\-generation platforms such as Boomi or MuleSoft. Responsibilities: **Architect, Design and Develop*** RESTful and SOAP APIs, event\-driven integrations, and message\-based workflows using WSO2 API Manager and WSO2 Micro Integrator. * Architect and implement system\-to\-system integration patterns including point\-to\-point, hub\-and\-spoke, and publish\-subscribe models. **Collaborate and Coordinate*** Collaborate with application owners, data engineers, and infrastructure engineers to define integration contracts, SLAs, and data exchange standards. **Production Support*** Develop and maintain API documentation, integration design specs, and runbooks. * Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize integration pipelines for performance, reliability, and security. * Enforce API security best practices including OAuth 2\.0, JWT, mutual TLS, rate limiting, and threat protection policies. * Participate in on\-call production support rotation and respond to integration incidents per SLA. * Contribute to CI/CD pipeline setup and DevOps practices for integration deployments. Qualifications: o Linux / Shell scripting o Python programming o SQL (query authoring and data validation) o Basic networking (DNS, HTTP/S, TCP/IP, proxies, firewalls) o Cloud infrastructure fundamentals (any major provider) o IAM: LDAP, Active Directory, OAuth 2\.0, certificate management * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with REST API development with various integration patterns * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with Boomi or MuleSoft integration platforms * Proficiency in designing and consuming RESTful APIs; working knowledge of SOAP, GraphQL, and AsyncAPI * Strong programming skills in Python and/or Java for integration scripting and transformation logic * Proficient in SQL for data querying and validation across integration workflows * Linux/Unix environment fluency including Shell scripting for automation and deployment * Understanding of basic networking concepts: DNS, HTTP/S, TCP/IP, proxies, firewalls, and load balancers * Experience with IAM concepts: LDAP, Active Directory, OAuth 2\.0, SAML, and role\-based access control * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure basics (AWS, Azure, or GCP): virtual networks, storage, managed services * Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent) * Ability to read and produce integration design documentation and API specifications (OpenAPI/Swagger) * Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field. **PREFERRED:*** 7\+ years of hands\-on experience with REST API development with various integration patterns * 7\+ years of hands\-on experience with Boomi or MuleSoft integration platforms * Hands\-on experience with WSO2 API Manager and/or WSO2 Micro Integrator (ESB/EI) * Exposure to event streaming platforms such as Apache Kafka or WSO2 Streaming Integrator * Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) for integration runtime deployments * Knowledge of enterprise integration patterns (EIP) Princeton University is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If the salary range on the posted position shows an hourly rate, this is the baseline; the actual hourly rate may be higher, depending on the position and factors listed above. jobs.title: Data Security Sales Specialist-Commercial
jobs.description: **About Us:** Proofpoint is a global leader in human\- and agent\-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people. **How We Work:** At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values: **Bold** in how we dream and innovate **Responsive** to feedback, challenges and opportunities **Accountable** for results and best in class outcomes **Visionary** in future focused problem\-solving **Exceptional** in execution and impact Department Overview The Data Security Specialist team at Proofpoint is an exciting, fast\-growing organization comprised of passionate, talented professionals dedicated to helping customers protect their most valuable asset: Data. As one of Proofpoint’s key growth engines, the team supports a world\-class customer base and drives adoption of an industry\-leading Data Security platform and solutions spanning Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Insider Risk Management, SaaS Data Protection, and Data Security for AI capabilities. As organizations increasingly embrace Generative AI and AI\-powered business workflows, the Data Security team plays a critical role in helping customers innovate securely while maintaining visibility, governance, and control over sensitive information. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Data Security Sales Specialist to align with our **Commercial Central and East** team. Must reside Utah or Pittsburg, PA Reporting to the Director of Data Security Specialists, you will partner closely with Proofpoint’s core sales organization to drive growth across the region. Acting as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, you will help customers develop and execute modern data security strategies that address evolving risks across cloud, SaaS, insider threats, and AI\-driven environments. As organizations accelerate the adoption of AI, you will guide customers in protecting sensitive data, reducing AI\-related risk, and enabling innovation securely through Proofpoint’s Data Security platform. In this role, you will act as a strategic Data Security Specialist, partnering with account teams to develop, influence, and advance data security opportunities. You will bring consultative expertise to customer conversations, collaborate with partners, sales leadership, and technical teams, and help align Proofpoint’s data security capabilities to customer priorities, risk reduction goals, and measurable business outcomes. Your Day\-to\-Day * Build strong relationships across customer organizations and within Proofpoint to drive opportunities from discovery through close. * Partner with core account teams to expand Proofpoint’s Data Security footprint within existing customers while identifying and capturing net\-new opportunities. * Lead customers and core sellers through the Data Security sales cycle utilizing industry best practices and Proofpoint’s proven methodologies for evaluating modern data security platforms. * Act as a strategic advisor to customers navigating data security challenges related to cloud transformation, insider risk, regulatory compliance, and AI adoption. * Drive conversations around Data Security for AI, helping organizations secure sensitive data used by Generative AI applications, AI copilots, SaaS AI capabilities, and emerging agentic workflows. * Collaborate with Sales Engineers to develop account strategies, deliver impactful demonstrations, facilitate workshops, and execute proof\-of\-value and proof\-of\-concept programs. * Partner with the channel ecosystem to expand market share and accelerate Data Security growth across the region. * Develop and execute strategic account plans focused on pipeline generation, customer expansion, competitive displacement, and long\-term platform adoption. * Drive ongoing enablement of Proofpoint’s Data Security portfolio across the sales organization through training sessions, office hours, sales updates, role plays, and territory\-specific support. * Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and opportunity progression through Salesforce, and related sales tools. What You Bring to the Team * Proven success selling Data Security solutions into Enterprise and Strategic accounts. * Experience with one or more of the following solution areas: Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Insider Risk Management (IRM/ITM), Cloud and SaaS Data Protection, Security Service Edge (SSE)/SASE, AI Security, AI Governance, or AI Risk Management. * Strong understanding of modern data security challenges across cloud, SaaS, AI, and hybrid enterprise environments. * Ability to engage executive stakeholders and articulate both business value and technical differentiation. * Exceptional discovery, presentation, relationship\-building, and consultative selling skills. * Strong strategic account planning, territory management, and forecasting capabilities. * Ability to thrive in a matrixed environment and build trust across cross\-functional stakeholders. **Why Proofpoint?** At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us: * Competitive compensation * Comprehensive benefits * Career success on your terms * Flexible work environment * Annual wellness and community outreach days * Always on recognition for your contributions * Global collaboration and networking opportunities **Our Culture:** Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success\-every day, for everyone. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to accessibility@proofpoint.com. **How to Apply** Interested? Submit your application along with any supporting information\- we can’t wait to hear from you!

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Job Summary:** The Senior Embedded Software Engineer will design, develop, and support the embedded software and firmware at the heart of Qnergy's products – from bare\-metal microcontroller firmware to embedded Linux systems. This is a senior hands\-on individual contributor role with broad ownership across the embedded stack, working closely with electrical, mechanical, and software engineers. As the company grows, this role has a path to grow into a technical leadership position for the embedded discipline. **Responsibilities:** * Design, implement, and maintain bare\-metal and RTOS\-based firmware (STM32 / FreeRTOS) for engine controllers, supervisory/system controllers, power electronics, and monitoring systems. * Develop and support embedded Linux platforms, including system services, networking, and device integration. * Own productization aspects of firmware: bootloaders, over\-the\-air / field firmware updates, secure boot, flash and file systems, watchdogs, and low\-power operation. * Integrate and support communication interfaces: fieldbus protocols (e.g., Modbus RTU/TCP, CAN, RS\-485\), remote connectivity (e.g., cellular/LTE), and cloud telemetry (e.g., MQTT, HTTP) feeding the Qnergy Dashboard. * Debug complex cross\-domain issues using lab equipment (oscilloscope, logic analyzer, debuggers) and contribute to hardware design reviews and board bring\-up. * Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, and cloud/software teams on architecture, interfaces, and design tradeoffs. * Establish and improve engineering practices for embedded development: version control, code reviews, automated builds, CI/CD for firmware, hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, and effective use of modern development and AI\-assisted tooling. * Support manufacturing, field service, and customer\-facing teams in diagnosing and resolving issues from returned or deployed units. * Document designs, interfaces, and test procedures to a standard appropriate for safety and reliability\-critical products. Requirements: **Education \& Experience:** * 7\+ years of professional experience in embedded systems, firmware, or embedded software development. * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field – or equivalent practical experience. * Experience shipping embedded products that operate in the field (industrial, IoT, energy, automotive, aerospace, or similar). * Experience taking products from development through certification, manufacturing, and field deployment is a strong plus. **Skills \& Abilities:** *Must\-have:* * Strong proficiency in C (and/or C\+\+) for resource\-constrained, bare\-metal and RTOS environments. * Hands\-on experience with STM32 (or similar ARM Cortex\-M) microcontrollers and FreeRTOS (or a comparable RTOS). * Working experience with embedded Linux (e.g., OpenWrt, Yocto, or Buildroot\-based systems), including device configuration, networking, and cross\-compilation. * Experience with bootloaders, OTA/firmware update mechanisms, secure boot, and flash/file system design. * Proficiency with common communication buses and protocols: UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet. * Able to read and interpret schematics and datasheets. * Comfortable debugging with lab equipment: oscilloscope, logic analyzer, JTAG/SWD debuggers, and multimeters. * Solid understanding of embedded system fundamentals: interrupts, DMA, timers, ADCs, power management, and memory\-constrained design. * Disciplined engineering habits: version control (Git), code reviews, and structured testing of embedded code. *Nice\-to\-have:* * Ability to contribute to hardware design: schematic review, component selection, and board bring\-up. * Experience with PCB design tools (e.g., Altium, KiCad). * Experience with industrial fieldbus protocols (Modbus RTU/TCP, CANopen) and RS\-485 networks. * Experience with cellular/LTE or other remote connectivity modules, and with IoT telemetry protocols (MQTT, HTTP/REST). * Familiarity with firmware security practices: secure boot chains, encrypted updates, and key storage. * Experience with CI/CD for firmware, automated testing, or hardware\-in\-the\-loop test rigs. * Familiarity with safety or reliability\-critical development practices (e.g., functional safety standards). * Exposure to cloud\-side integration (device management, provisioning, dashboards). **Work Environment:** * This is an on\-site role based at our Ogden, Utah facility, with regular access to hardware, lab equipment, and test fixtures. * Regular use of a computer keyboard is required. * Regularly sits for several hours per shift; occasional standing work at lab benches. * Ability to read and interpret schematics, datasheets, and technical documents. * Performs detailed work on multiple concurrent projects.

jobs.title: Embedded DSP Software Engineer, Senior
jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> DSP Architecture and Design **General Summary:** As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next\-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Software Engineer, you will design, develop, create, modify, and validate embedded and cloud edge software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs that launch cutting\-edge, world class products that meet and exceed customer needs. Qualcomm Software Engineers collaborate with systems, hardware, architecture, test engineers, and other teams to design system\-level software solutions and obtain information on performance requirements and interfaces. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field and 2\+ years of Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience. OR Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field and 1\+ year of Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience. OR PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field. * 2\+ years of experience with high\-performance microprocessor design. Qualcomm is looking for a Senior Software Engineer who applies his technical knowledge and skills to develop embedded platform software for CPU, DSP, and NPU processors (and associated AI engines) in our Snapdragon SoC portfolio. In this role, you will utilize your solid foundation in embedded software, operating systems, and drivers – along with a deep understanding of high\-performance processor architecture (multi\-core, multi\-threading, caching, etc.) – to deploy and optimize platform software for complex multimedia and machine learning use cases running on our SoCs. The ideal candidate has significant experience in C/C\+\+ programming, real\-time operating systems, driver development, and computer architecture, and has successfully optimized software on resource\-constrained platforms. Experience with PCIe or Windows MCDM/WDDM driver stacks is a plus. As part of the **AI Infra** team, you will work on software at all levels of the stack that enables DSP acceleration for AI inference, computer vision, video/audio processing, and more. Key responsibilities include: * Designing, and developing multi\-processor multimedia and AI frameworks that span across CPU, DSP, and NPU. * Developing high\-performance drivers and runtime libraries to unlock the full potential of specialized DSP and AI hardware. * Profiling and optimizing system performance, applying knowledge of advanced DSP architecture and microarchitecture\-level optimizations to achieve low latency and low power. * Collaborating with cross\-functional teams (hardware, tools, and firmware) to evaluate design trade\-offs and incorporate custom instructions or features that improve performance. * Integrating and testing software on target devices; working closely with global teams and occasionally with OEM customers and partners to support commercialization. In recent years, there has been increased focus at the Bank on automating and integrating business processes across applications. This role will work with various inputs into integrations, call enterprise services for supplemental data and interact with the proprietary banking API. Develop new routine applications to meet business requirements. * Analyze system requirements, including identifying program interactions and appropriate interfaces between impacted components and sub systems. * Team collaboration is key for this role; follow guidance of Lead Engineers to maintain standards and design patterns, as well as provide guidance to others in areas of expertise, as needed. * Make recommendations towards the development of new code or the reuse of existing code. * May recommend new technologies and methodologies to management for meeting business needs, resolving problems and exploiting opportunities. Remains current with new technologies. * Participate in software system testing, deployments, validation procedures and technical documentation. * Write and/or review system specifications, including output requirements and flow charts. * Assists in preparing project plans by providing tasks and estimates of effort. * Perform Developer Integration Testing; document test results. * Ensure proper analysis of problems and programming approaches to prevent rework and delays. * Occasionally work a non\-standard shift including nights and/or weekends and/or have on\-call responsibilities. * Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned. **Skills/Previous Experience:** * Three (3\) to five (5\) or years of experience in Design, Development and Support of Data\-Driven, highly scalable multi\-tier applications. Preferred: * Financial industry background is a plus. * Experience with some job scheduling tool is a plus. * Oracle database experience is a plus to have. * AI tool (GitHub copilot, Claude, etc. ) experience is nice to have. * Angular 16 or onwards, HTML 5, CSS and Typescript is a nice to have. **Licenses/Certifications:** * None required. **Education** Bachelor’s: Computer and Information Science, Bachelor’s: Computer Engineering, Bachelor’s: Data Science, High School (HS) (Required) **Work Experience** General Experience \- 3 to 6 years **Certifications** **Travel** Less than 25% **Workstyle** Hybrid The total compensation for this position includes base salary or wages, and may include components such as additional compensation (cash or equity), discretionary bonuses, or commissions. Make an impact from day one \- lead improvements that enhance reliability, quality, and performance as you build, develop, and optimize systems for our highly\-regulated biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes. In this role, you'll provide technical leadership and partner with Manufacturing, Quality Control, Facilities, Engineering, and Validation teams to maintain system reliability, drive continuous improvement, and deliver automation projects that support operational excellence. Ability to remove jewelry, make\-up and nail adornments when wearing cleanroom attire is required. Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! jobs.title: Senior Water Resources Engineer / Project Manager
jobs.description: **About RIVUS Consulting** RIVUS Consulting is a certified DBE/SBE/MBE engineering and environmental consulting firm providing innovative solutions to public\-sector clients. Our services span planning, engineering design, environmental permitting, program and construction management, inspection, GIS, asset management, and data systems. Our core technical areas include stormwater, drainage and flood resilience, water resources, transportation infrastructure, environmental compliance, stream restoration, and public works program delivery. RIVUS is continuing to expand its presence in North Texas and is seeking an experienced professional who can combine strong technical and project\-management capabilities with client development and Dallas office leadership. **Position Overview** RIVUS Consulting is seeking a **Senior Water Resources Engineer / Project Manager** to lead hydrology, hydraulics, stormwater, drainage, floodplain, water\-quality, and stream\-restoration projects while helping expand the firm's presence in the Dallas–Fort Worth market. The position will manage feasibility studies, engineering analyses, design documentation, permitting, construction support, and multidisciplinary project teams. The successful candidate should have strong experience with H\&H modeling, drainage infrastructure, floodplain management, watershed studies, MS4/TMDL programs, and public\-sector infrastructure projects. Experience with coastal, resilience, or advanced flood modeling—including tidal, surge, shoreline, or climate\-resilience applications—is desirable. In addition to technical responsibilities, this position will play an important role in **Dallas office management and business development**. The individual will represent RIVUS with clients, teaming partners, professional organizations, and public agencies and help develop a sustainable backlog of work in North Texas. **Key Responsibilities** **Technical and Project Management** * Manage mid\-sized to large\-scale stormwater, drainage, flood\-control, watershed, and water\-resources projects. * Perform and/or oversee hydrologic and hydraulic modeling and engineering analyses. * Lead preparation of feasibility studies, design reports, plans, specifications, cost estimates, and technical memoranda. * Manage floodplain, drainage, stormwater\-quality, stream\-restoration, and MS4\-related assignments. * Coordinate environmental and regulatory permitting. * Provide technical oversight during design and construction. * Manage project scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client expectations. * Coordinate multidisciplinary staff, subconsultants, and teaming partners. * Review technical work products and provide QA/QC. * Mentor junior engineers and support their technical and professional development. **Dallas Office Management** * Support the day\-to\-day coordination and growth of RIVUS's Dallas\-area operations. * Help establish an effective local office presence and maintain communication with RIVUS corporate leadership. * Coordinate workloads and assignments for Dallas\-area technical staff. * Support recruiting, onboarding, mentoring, and development of local staff as the office grows. * Help maintain accountability for project delivery, utilization, schedules, and client commitments. * Assist leadership with identifying staffing and technical resources needed to support the Texas backlog. * Represent RIVUS's culture, professional standards, and commitment to client service in the North Texas market. **Business Development and Client Relations** * Develop and maintain relationships with public\-sector clients, prime consultants, teaming partners, and industry organizations throughout North Texas. * Help identify upcoming opportunities with municipalities, counties, transportation agencies, river authorities, water districts, and other public agencies. * Represent RIVUS at targeted industry meetings, conferences, procurement events, and client meetings. * Develop relationships with larger engineering firms where RIVUS can participate as a DBE/SBE/MBE teaming partner. * Participate in client visits, introductory meetings, project debriefings, and industry networking. * Track procurement forecasts and upcoming solicitations relevant to RIVUS's technical capabilities. * Assist with go/no\-go decisions, teaming strategies, capture planning, and proposal development. * Participate in preparation of statements of qualifications, technical proposals, scopes, fees, and interview presentations. * Help convert RIVUS's Texas certifications and technical capabilities into sustainable project backlog. * Identify cross\-selling opportunities involving water resources, drainage, transportation, structural engineering, environmental services, GIS/data systems, inspection, and program/construction management. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Water Resources Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. * Professional Engineer (PE) license required; Texas PE strongly preferred or ability to obtain Texas registration. * Approximately **10\+ years of progressively responsible experience** in water resources, drainage, stormwater, floodplain, or related civil engineering. * Demonstrated experience managing public\-sector engineering projects. * Strong knowledge of hydrologic and hydraulic modeling. * Experience with commonly used H\&H software such as HEC\-RAS, HEC\-HMS, XP\-SWMM/InfoWorks ICM, SWMM, or comparable platforms. * Experience preparing drainage studies, floodplain analyses, construction plans, specifications, and cost estimates. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to interact effectively with agency staff, clients, teaming partners, contractors, and technical personnel. * Experience developing client relationships, proposals, or new business is strongly preferred. * Existing relationships within the Dallas–Fort Worth engineering/public\-infrastructure market are highly desirable. **Preferred Experience** Experience working with or pursuing opportunities involving organizations such as: * TxDOT * NTTA * NCTCOG * Trinity River Authority * North Texas municipalities and counties * Water districts and river authorities * USACE * FEMA * TCEQ Experience in transportation drainage, bridge/roadway hydraulics, structural coordination, flood mitigation, watershed planning, environmental permitting, utilties, or program/construction management is also desirable. **Leadership Opportunity** This position is intended for an engineer who wants to remain technically engaged while assuming increasing responsibility for **projects, clients, staff, and growth of RIVUS's Dallas operation**. As the North Texas backlog expands, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow into a broader office and regional leadership position. The key change we had made was to make the position **not just a senior technical engineer**, but someone accountable for helping build the Dallas backlog, managing the local office presence, attending industry/client events, and developing relationships with agencies and primes. Flexible work from home options available.

computer science * 1 \- 3 years of experience with embedded systems * Experience with low voltage electrical systems * Experience with signal processing **Preferred Experience:** * Knowledge of control systems. * Experience with vehicle electric DC \& AC generation and supply, multiplex wiring. * Knowledge of firefighting processes and equipment. **Language Skills:** * Read and interpret common scientific and technical journals and documents. * Excellent oral and written communication skills. **Mathematical Skills:** * Work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference. * Interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables. * Able to apply mathematical jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.description: ***Urgently hiring***, we're growing fast and we need engineers as soon as possible! This could be you! We make a **commitment** to try and get back to all applicants **within 5 business days**. The interview process is also relatively straightforward: * A brief technical screen \+ product\-related questions. * A flight and accommodations to NYC for a 1\.5 hour interview comprised of a 1\-hour final technical component and a 30 min behavioral chat afterwards. We move *fast*, we hire remotely and hybrid, but we prefer in\-person in NYC. If you get the position we will happily work with you to pay a significant relocation bonus and help you find a lease (via our 3rd\-party placement services in NYC who will literally advise and help you tour apartments all day). **SAJA** is a venture\-backed startup funded by top investors. We're building a new way to collect, trade, and engage with physical collectibles through a digital\-first experience. We're growing rapidly so we're looking for a Software Engineer with 0\-3 years of experience to help us build and ship the product, primarily on iOS, with room to work across the stack as you grow. **What you'll do** * Build and ship features in our iOS app, from the pack\-opening experience to collection management to payments. * Work across the stack when a feature needs it, including the TypeScript backend that powers the app. * Take features from a rough idea to something in front of real users, and stay with them after launch. * Debug issues in production, including the ones that only show up on real devices and real networks. * Work with design, product, and the rest of engineering to figure out what's worth building and what it should actually do. * Help us make good decisions about testing, reliability, and how we handle anything that touches money. **What we're looking for** * Strong fundamentals in at least one language, and the ability to pick up others quickly. We use Swift and SwiftUI on iOS and TypeScript on the backend, but we care far more that you can learn a stack than that you already know ours. * Some experience building something real, whether that's a personal project, an internship, or coursework you took further than required. We'd rather see one thing you shipped and can talk about in depth than a long list of technologies. * The instinct to figure out why something is broken rather than trying fixes until one works. * Ability to take an underspecified problem and ask the right questions before writing code. * Comfort making decisions with incomplete information, and knowing when to ask instead. * Interest in consumer products, marketplaces, gaming, collectibles, fintech, or e\-commerce. * Comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment with significant ownership. * Strong ability to be AI\-forward with tools such as Claude Code, Codex, and a yearly $100k token budget allotted to you. **What this job is actually like** You'll ship to production early, in your first couple of weeks. You'll work across most of the product rather than one corner of it, and you'll have someone senior to learn from while you do. It moves quickly, the codebase is young, and you'll have real influence over how things get built. Although preferred, you do not need experience in collectibles or trading cards, or prior iOS experience if you're a strong engineer elsewhere. We care much more about your ability to think critically, learn quickly, and build things that work. **Location** We're headquartered in NYC and most of the team is here, but we hire remote and hybrid. If you're in the city, you'll find people in the office everyday. If you're not, we make sure you're not a second\-class participant, and we'll fly you in regularly so you get real time with the team. **Compensation** $200,000–$300,000 base, plus meaningful early\-stage equity (0\.5\-2%). The range reflects real differences in experience and demonstrated ability. We'll tell you where we think you land and why. Additional equity compensation a serious part of the offer, not a rounding error, and we're happy to walk you through the numbers so you can actually evaluate it. **Benefits** * Medical, dental, and vision, with premiums fully covered for you and heavily subsidized for dependents * 401(k) * Unlimited PTO * 16 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents * Top\-spec laptop, monitors, and whatever else makes you effective; home office stipend if you're remote * $100k annual AI token budget, plus a small learning and conference budget * Commuter benefits for NYC\-based folks * Regular offsites and team dinners * Lunch provided in the office Even if you do not meet all the qualifications, feel free to apply if you think there might be a role for you at SAJA. Drive and passion are by far our favorite markers for success. **Please do not apply to multiple roles within Saja. We will automatically consider you for other roles, but please apply to only one role.** Pay: $200,000\.00 \- $300,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Gym membership * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Pet insurance * Relocation assistance * Unlimited paid time off * Visa sponsorship * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10007

jobs.description: : **Full Stack Developer, EVAAS** **– Hybrid, Cary, North Carolina** We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence – and questions into answers. If you’re looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world\-class employee experience, you’ll find it here. We’re recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more. **About the job** As a Full Stack Developer on the SAS EVAAS (Education Visualization and Analytics System) team, you will get in on the ground floor of a new identity solution that will shape the future of secure customer access to EVAAS applications. In this role, you will work across the application stack to build secure, reliable, user\-centered web applications, with a particular focus on identity management, authentication, authorization, and single sign\-on capabilities that make a difference for students, educators, and the organizations we serve. **As a** **Full Stack Developer, EVAAS****, you will:** * Design, develop, test, and maintain full stack features for an Identity Solution across front\-end, back\-end, API, and database layers. * Build and enhance secure authentication and authorization workflows, including single sign\-on integrations for customer\-facing applications. * Work with identity management systems and standards such as SAML, OAuth, and OpenID Connect to support scalable and repeatable access patterns. * Collaborate with product, security, DevOps, and engineering teammates to deliver a highly reliable Identity Solution with strong SLA expectations that enables customer connectivity to the EVAAS reporting application. * Apply your skills and experience to help shape the future of our web application and identity architecture. * Be encouraged to participate in open\-source projects on behalf of SAS. * Ensure all applicable security policies and processes are followed to support the organization’s secure software development goals. * Embrace curiosity, passion, authenticity and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do. **Required qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. * Minimum 5 years of experience developing and delivering web\-based applications. * Experience with full stack development, including front\-end technologies, back\-end services, APIs, and relational databases. * Hands\-on experience with Java. * Experience with identity management systems, authentication, authorization, and single sign\-on concepts. * Familiarity with SAML\-based integrations and related identity standards such as OAuth or OpenID Connect. * Experience using version control systems and collaborative software development practices. * Equivalent combination of related education, training and experience may be considered in place of the above qualifications. **Additional** **competencies,** **knowledge** **and skills** * Initiating Action: Taking prompt action to accomplish work goals; taking action to achieve results beyond what is required; being proactive. * Technology Savvy: Leveraging one’s practical knowledge and understanding of recent technology tools, solutions, and trends to improve work results, solve work problems, and take advantage of new business opportunities. * Work Standards: Setting high standards of performance for self and others; assuming responsibility and accountability for successfully completing assignments or tasks; self\-imposing standards of excellence rather than having standards imposed. * Experience with Keycloak, Okta, Auth0, or similar identity and access management platforms. * Experience configuring or supporting SSO integrations for enterprise or customer\-facing web applications. * Experience with the Spring Framework or related Java web application frameworks. * Experience with Maven and the Project Object Model (POM). * Experience with JavaScript, front\-end frameworks, or modern web application development practices. * Experience with Microsoft SQL Server or other relational database platforms. * Experience with Git, GitHub, and CI/CD workflows. * Experience documenting technical decisions, integration patterns, processes, and code. **World\-class benefits** Highlights include... * Comprehensive medical, prescription, dental and vision plans. * Medical plan options include: + PPO with low annual deductible and copays. + HDHP combined with a health savings account with a contribution from SAS (no access to on\-site health care center). * Onsite Health Care Center (HQ) that’s free to employees and family members enrolled in the PPO plan. There’s a pharmacy too! Not local to HQ? jobs.description: Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960\. Some of the key products as part of the digital portfolio are – mobile and desktop applications, vehicle connectivity solutions, mapping services, production, inventory and planning optimization, servicing and repairs, and more. At the same time, you'll have plenty of opportunities to be hands\-on building key systems and will be directly responsible for the successful delivery of complex and large\-scale technical efforts as well as acting as a technical mentor and leader for other engineers. **What you'll do** Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick\-up truck \& rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: * Work with engineers \& technical leaders across the company to ship interoperable products and systems on strong foundations that manage customer interactions inside and outside of the vehicle * Lead the architecture, design, and development of complex software systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications and deliverables * Implement single sign\-on solutions to allow users to authenticate once and access multiple applications securely. Design, implement, and support identity, access, and profile\-related services for multiple web applications, supporting both internal and customer users. * Implement best practices and standards for software development, including code reviews, testing, and documentation * Mentor and coach junior team members, providing guidance and support to help them grow and succeed * Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, continuously learning and experimenting with new tools and techniques to improve our software development process * Be responsible for the services that are owned by your team, ensuring 24/7 on\-call coverage **Location \& Travel Expectations**: * This role will be based out of the Scout Motors office in **Fremont, CA.** * This role requires 1\-3 days per week in the office, with regular in\-person meetings and events. * Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time. * Travel: Domestic travel required. Valid driver's license required. #### **What you'll bring** We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You'll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment. You'll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring: * **Education/Certifications**: A bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field * **Years of Experience** required in type of role: 5\+ years in software development with the ability to lead multiple projects, focusing on back\-end technologies * **Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders * Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment, both independently and as part of a team * Proficiency in one of Go (preferably), Node.js, Python, Java, or Ruby * Experience with relational and/or non\-relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL and Redis (preferably), MySQL, and/or MongoDB) * Experience with identity management systems (e.g., Azure AD, AWS Cognito, LDAP, Okta) and directory services for user authentication and management * Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and best practices * Excellent problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills, with a passion for finding elegant solutions to complex challenges **Preferred:** * Prior work experience in a manufacturing or automotive environment * Hands\-on experience building on AWS using Go and/or Python #### **What you'll gain** The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights: * Competitive insurance including: + Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans * 401(k) program with: + An employer match and immediate vesting * Generous Paid Time Off including: + 20 days planned PTO, as accrued + 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually + Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders + Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave #### **Pay Transparency** This is a full\-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent. Initial base salary range \= $140,000\.00 \- $170,000\.00 Initial California base salary range\= $154,000 \- $187,000 Internal leveling code: IC9 **Notice to applicants:** * To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older. * Residing in **San Francisco**: *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* * Residing in **Los Angeles**: *Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.* * Residing in **New York City**: *This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.* **Equal Opportunity** Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: AI/ML Engineer **Location:** Atlanta, Georgia **Employment Type:** Full\-time About Sobo Sobo is building an AI\-powered business operator intelligence platform designed to help small and midsized businesses identify operational challenges, uncover opportunities, and connect insights to action. Our platform combines proprietary AI systems, business diagnostics, connected data, and expert support to help business leaders make better decisions across operations, finance, growth, technology, and organizational performance. We are looking for an experienced Senior AI/ML Engineer to work directly with our Head of AI Product \& Development and help build the full Sobo platform. About the Role This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who can take AI capabilities from concept and experimentation through production deployment. You will help architect, develop, test, and scale the intelligence layer behind Sobo. Your work will include model development, data pipelines, AI agents and workflows, platform integrations, evaluation systems, production APIs, and the infrastructure required to deliver reliable AI\-powered experiences to customers. This position is well suited for an experienced builder who is comfortable operating in an early\-stage environment, solving ambiguous problems, and taking meaningful ownership of technical outcomes. What You’ll Do * Work directly with the Head of AI Product \& Development to define and execute Sobo’s technical roadmap. * Design, develop, and improve Sobo’s AI and machine\-learning capabilities. * Build production\-ready AI workflows, agents, recommendation systems, and decision\-support tools. * Develop systems that transform business and operational data into relevant, actionable insights. * Build and maintain retrieval, inference, evaluation, and model\-monitoring pipelines. * Integrate AI capabilities with Sobo’s application, databases, APIs, and third\-party business platforms. * Improve the quality, accuracy, explainability, reliability, and security of AI\-generated outputs. * Create scalable data pipelines for structured and unstructured business information. * Evaluate models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on performance, cost, reliability, and customer requirements. * Translate product and business requirements into practical technical solutions. * Write clean, maintainable, well\-documented production code. * Help establish engineering standards, testing practices, documentation, and deployment processes. * Participate in architecture decisions and help shape the long\-term technical foundation of the Sobo platform. * Assist with the growth and development of Sobo’s future engineering team. What We’re Looking For * Demonstrated professional experience building and deploying AI or machine\-learning systems in production. * Strong proficiency in Python and modern AI/ML development frameworks. * Experience with large language models, natural\-language processing, generative AI, or related technologies. * Experience developing APIs, backend services, data pipelines, and cloud\-based applications. * Understanding of retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI\-agent workflows. * Experience working with structured and unstructured data from multiple sources. * Familiarity with model deployment, monitoring, versioning, testing, and MLOps practices. * Strong understanding of software engineering principles, system architecture, databases, and secure development. * Ability to balance experimentation with the discipline required to ship reliable production software. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills. * Ability to work collaboratively while independently owning major technical initiatives. * Comfort working in a fast\-moving startup where priorities may evolve as the product and customer base grow. Preferred Experience * Experience building AI\-powered B2B SaaS products. * Experience developing multi\-agent or workflow\-based AI systems. * Familiarity with financial, operational, CRM, ERP, payroll, or other business\-platform data. * Experience integrating platforms such as QuickBooks, Xero, Gusto, HubSpot, or similar systems. * Experience with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure. * Experience supporting AI systems involving sensitive business or customer data. * Previous experience in an early\-stage startup or building a product from its foundational stages. * Experience mentoring engineers or helping establish an engineering function. What Success Looks Like In this role, you will help turn Sobo’s product vision into a secure, scalable, and commercially viable platform. Success means shipping dependable AI capabilities, improving the quality of Sobo’s business insights, building systems that can scale with customer adoption, and creating a strong technical foundation for future product and engineering growth. Why Join Sobo? * Help build an ambitious AI platform from an early and influential stage. * Work directly with Sobo’s Head of AI Product \& Development and company leadership. * Take meaningful ownership of architecture, product capabilities, and technical execution. * Solve real operational problems for small and midsized businesses. * Help shape the engineering culture and future technical team. * Join an Atlanta\-based company operating at the intersection of artificial intelligence, business intelligence, and expert\-led execution. Compensation and Work Arrangement This is a paid, full\-time position based in Atlanta, Georgia. Compensation will be determined based on experience, technical background, and the scope of responsibility. How to Apply Please submit your résumé or LinkedIn profile, along with a brief description of an AI/ML product or production system you have helped build. If available, include links to relevant projects, technical portfolios, GitHub repositories, or other examples of your work. Sobo is an equal\-opportunity employer. We welcome qualified applicants from all backgrounds and evaluate candidates based on their skills, experience, and ability to contribute to the team. Pay: $69,026\.02 \- $83,128\.11 per year Work Location: In person

caching technologies, such as Cassandra, Aurora, Aerospike, Kafka, AWS MSK, Redis, DynamoDB, or ElastiCache. * Understanding of database and distributed\-system concepts such as replication, tests. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with an interest in infrastructure automation and distributed\-system reliability. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building internal developer platforms, self\-service infrastructure, or infrastructure APIs. * Experience using AI/ML or generative AI to improve infrastructure automation, operational workflows, incident management, observability, or developer productivity. * Familiarity with agent\-assisted workflows, structured outputs, tool\-calling integrations, approval controls, or policy\-based infrastructure automation. * Relevant AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, database, or streaming\-platform
