jobs.title: Senior Game Producer
jobs.description: TapBlaze is looking for a Senior Game Producer to help us run and scale production across Good Pizza, Great Pizza, Good Coffee, Great Coffee, and future titles. You will own production across our live games, turning product and creative direction into clear, executable plans and driving releases from approved concept through launch and post\-launch verification. Your responsibility is to make sure the complete player experience ships correctly and on time, not simply to update Jira or report status. You will work closely with the product leadership in Los Angeles while coordinating execution between our Los Angeles team and our publishing partner in Beijing. For major live events, platform featuring opportunities, content updates, and releases, you will be the person making sure every function is aligned, dependencies are visible, risks are surfaced early, and nothing falls between teams. **What You Will Own** ===================== **End\-to\-End Launch \& Release Ownership** -------------------------------------------- * Own production for major live events, features, content updates, platform promotions, and releases from approved concept through launch and post\-launch verification. * Build launch plans with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, content locks, QA windows, release candidates, and go/no\-go checkpoints. * Make sure Product, Engineering, Art, Narrative, QA, Localization, Marketing, and platform requirements come together as one coherent launch. * Surface risks early and drive tradeoff discussions with the appropriate product, creative, and functional owners. **Turn Designs Into Executable Production Plans** ------------------------------------------------- * Ensure approved design/product specifications are current, complete, and treated as the single source of truth. * Translate initiatives into clear Jira epics, tasks, owners, dependencies, and deadlines; partner with functional owners to refine technical and discipline\-specific subtasks. * Make sure Engineering and QA are never expected to implement or test from outdated Slack messages or ambiguous documentation. * Establish and enforce practical standards for design handoff, task readiness, change tracking, and acceptance criteria. **Cross\-Functional \& LA–Beijing Production** ---------------------------------------------- * Coordinate production between our Los Angeles team and our publishing partner in Beijing, keeping priorities, dependencies, handoffs, and deadlines aligned across time zones. * Create enough overlap and communication structure that issues spanning TapBlaze and our publishing partner are resolved without depending on the CEO to connect the pieces. * Partner with team members and functional leads at TapBlaze and our publishing partner to clarify ownership, escalate blockers, and improve accountability. * Be comfortable working across cultures and time zones; Mandarin and/or prior China/APAC game\-development experience is a strong plus. **QA, Localization \& Release Readiness** ----------------------------------------- * Ensure QA coverage, test planning, regression scope, release\-candidate timing, and critical launch coverage are planned before they become emergencies. * Make localization part of the production plan from the beginning, including source\-string completeness, deadlines, implementation, and verification. * Run lightweight launch\-readiness reviews for important releases and make unresolved risks explicit before launch. * Ensure post\-release smoke testing and verification are assigned and completed. **Production Systems \& Continuous Improvement** ------------------------------------------------ * Build simple, scalable production processes that improve clarity and accountability without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. * Own Jira and production documentation as tools for execution—not as ends in themselves. * Run postmortems when launches or processes break down, identify root causes, and turn lessons into durable process improvements. * Develop clear escalation paths and operating rhythms for live games, including major releases and critical incidents. **You’re a Great Fit If ...** ============================= * You have 5\+ years of game production experience, including meaningful ownership of shipped or live\-operated games. * You have strong experience with mobile f2p live games, recurring content, live ops, or similarly fast release environments. * You have led cross\-functional production across multiple disciplines rather than only managing schedules for a single team. * You are highly organized, but your value is judgment and ownership, not just task administration and coordination. We are not looking for project manager type producers. * You naturally ask what is missing, who owns it, what can block launch, and what needs to happen next. * You are comfortable challenging unclear requirements, incomplete handoffs, unrealistic schedules, and unowned dependencies. * You can operate effectively in a small, hands\-on studio where leaders are expected to solve problems rather than pass them between departments. * Production experience with distributed teams, co\-development partners, or publishers is strongly preferred. * Experience working with teams in China or APAC is strongly preferred; Mandarin is a plus. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== * Major launches have a clearly accountable owner, current source\-of\-truth documentation, complete Jira execution plans, task owners, dependencies, and readiness checkpoints. * Product, Engineering, QA, Localization, and Marketing are aligned before release rather than discovering conflicts at the end. * Cross\-time\-zone execution between our Los Angeles team and our publishing partner in Beijing becomes predictable and transparent. * Problems are surfaced and resolved by the production organization before they need CEO intervention. * The team learns from misses and improves the system so the same failure does not recur. **How We Work** =============== This is a full\-time, five\-day\-per\-week in\-office position at TapBlaze’s Los Angeles studio, with no remote or hybrid option. We believe this role is most effective when deeply embedded with the team and able to resolve issues quickly in person. We believe *beauty is in the details*. If you have read this far, include that phrase somewhere in your application. **Physical Requirements** ========================= * Los Angeles, CA: Reliably commute or relocate before starting work; * Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer. **Compensation** ================ The range for this role is $100,000 to $125,000 depending on experience, with the opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. **Commitment to Diversity** =========================== As an equal opportunity employer committed to meeting the needs of a multigenerational and multicultural workforce, TAPBLAZE recognizes that a diverse staff, reflective of our community, is integral to our success. We hire talent at all levels regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, or disability, and actively foster inclusion within our company and across interactions with vendors and partners. Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact careers@tapblaze.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice

jobs.description: Job Description: Junior Customs Automation Assistant Position Title: Junior Customs Automation Assistant Department: Customs \& Trade Compliance / Engineering Location: On\-site Employment Type: Full\-Time 1\. Reporting Structure \& Working Relationships Indirect Line \& Technical Mentorship: Reports indirectly to CTIO Specialist / Systems Architect) for technical review, code quality standards, pipeline architecture approval, and skill mentorship. Operational Alignment: Reports directly to the VP of Customs to identify operational friction, gather process requirements, and understand customs bottlenecks. 2\. Role Summary We are seeking a motivated, hands\-on Junior Customs Automation Assistant (recent graduate or 1–2 years of practical experience) to join our Customs team. In this role, you will serve as the dedicated technical execution engine embedded directly in customs operations. You will work closely with the Director of Customs to discover and document manual bottlenecks (such as document review, pedimento verification, commercial invoice parsing, and tracking). Under the direct mentorship and technical supervision of our Lead Automation Architect, you will actively write code, build integrations, and maintain automated data pipelines using n8n, Claude’s API, JavaScript, and Python. While overarching architectural design and strategic system governance remain with leadership, you will be in the trenches developing practical scripts, connecting endpoints, transforming payloads, and deploying robust automations. 3\. Key Responsibilities Process Discovery \& Operational Collaboration Shadow customs specialists and review day\-to\-day trade documentation processes (e.g., pedimentos, bills of lading, commercial invoices, tariff classification sheets). Translate pain points identified by the Director of Customs into structured technical requirements and workflow flowcharts. Hands\-on Development \& Workflow Engineering Develop, test, and deploy automated pipelines in n8n utilizing Webhooks, HTTP Request nodes, split/merge branches, and sub\-workflows. Write custom scripts in JavaScript (inside n8n Code nodes) and Python to handle complex string parsing, regular expressions, JSON payload transformations, and data schema validations. Integrate Claude’s API (Anthropic) into production pipelines for intelligent document extraction, OCR text processing, classification, and structured JSON output generation. Construct and execute database queries (SQL) to read and write records across relational databases and operational repositories. Maintenance, Reliability \& Error Handling Monitor live pipeline executions and webhook logs daily to diagnose dropped payloads, failed retries, or unexpected API schema changes. Implement structured error\-catching routines (error workflows, alerting channels) to ensure customs operations run uninterrupted. Debug node failures and script exceptions methodically, presenting technical root\-cause analyses during mentoring reviews. Documentation \& Knowledge Transfer Maintain clear documentation for all developed workflows, including parameter definitions, environment variables, API endpoint contracts, and deployment notes. Create concise operational user guides for the Customs team when new automated features are rolled out. 4\. Technical Skills \& Requirements Area Requirement Experience Level Recent graduate (Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent) or 1–2 years of experience in junior development, technical support, or data integration. Workflow Platforms Practical experience building pipelines in n8n (preferred), or equivalent platforms (Make, Zapier) with a willingness to master n8n. Programming \& Scripting Foundational proficiency in JavaScript or Python, specifically for object/array manipulation, JSON parsing, and string cleansing. AI / LLM Integration Hands\-on familiarity with prompting and consuming LLM APIs (specifically Claude API via Anthropic) using structured outputs, schemas, and system instructions. APIs \& Web Protocols Clear understanding of REST APIs, Webhooks, HTTP status codes, headers, and authentication methods (Bearer tokens, API keys). Databases Working knowledge of relational databases and standard SQL queries (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, JOIN). Languages Professional working proficiency in both English and Spanish (written and verbal) to collaborate effectively between technical documentation and operational business teams. 5\. Nice\-to\-Have Skills (Not Required) Exposure to international trade documents, Mexican customs procedures, pedimentos, or tariff codes (fracciones arancelarias). Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker) or self\-hosted server basics. Experience with Git, version control, or CI/CD pipelines. Benefits: * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: In person

This role establishes application monitoring, analyzes data flows across systems and vendor integrations, and proactively resolves performance issues. As a senior contributor, this person also gatekeeps code quality by reviewing and approving team contributions, partners with product and engineering teams to shape the technical roadmap, and evaluates emerging technologies for platform fit. Working with QA and DevOps, they help define testing and deployment practices that strengthen system reliability and scalability. **DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** * **Application Ownership \& Codebase Management** Own and maintain the core application, including hands\-on management and cleanup of its monolithic architecture. Analyze end\-to\-end data flows between systems, the SaaS platform, and vendor integrations. Proactively identify performance bottlenecks and implement fixes directly. * **Database Integrity \& Risk Management** Safely perform and oversee direct production database changes — writing and executing queries and scripts using transactions, rollback capability, and audit logging so that no operation leaves data in a corrupted or unrecoverable state. Map current and future data flows, identifying risks to data integrity, privacy, and availability. Ensure compliance with privacy and security regulations and recommend best practices for secure data exchange and storage. * **Code Review \& Repository Gatekeeping** Review and approve code changes from contributing team members before they are merged into the repository, ensuring quality, security, and consistency standards are met. Act as the primary gatekeeper for repository access and contributions. * **Technology Strategy and Solutions** Collaborate with product, engineering, and customer teams to define the technical roadmap. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Machine Learning Engineer to join our dynamic and growing Data Platforms \& Solutions team. As a Machine Learning Engineer at Viking you will design, productionize, deploy, and operate machine learning solutions that support management decisions. This role bridges data science, data engineering, and software engineering. You will work closely with data scientists, data engineers, analysts, product partners, and software developers to translate experimental models into scalable, reliable, governed production systems on Databricks. The position emphasizes practical MLOps, robust feature and training pipelines, reproducibility, observability, and measurable business outcomes. **Job Responsibilities:** * Design, build, deploy, and maintain production\-grade machine learning solutions supporting demand forecasting, dynamic pricing, inventory optimization, and recommendation use cases. * Partner with data scientists to convert experimental notebooks and prototypes into modular, tested, repeatable training and inference pipelines. * Build and maintain feature engineering, model\-training, batch\-scoring, and real\-time inference workflows using Python, Spark, SQL, Databricks, and MLflow. * Implement MLOps practices for experiment tracking, model registration and versioning, automated testing, CI/CD, controlled promotion, rollback, and reproducibility. * Define and monitor model and operational health measures, including model quality, drift signals, latency, failures, data quality, resource utilization, and compute cost. * Validate model changes against reproducible datasets and established baselines, and assess downstream impact. * Integrate model outputs with business applications and downstream platforms through reliable batch jobs, APIs, and secure data\-access patterns. * Optimize model architecture, feature processing, training, and inference for scalability, reliability, maintainability, and cost efficiency. * Implement safeguards and fallback behavior so invalid data or failed optimization does not result in unsafe or misleading recommendations. * Collaborate with stakeholders to translate revenue\-management requirements into technical specifications, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes. * Create and maintain technical documentation, model cards, runbooks, deployment plans, monitoring procedures, and retraining and rollback strategies. * Ensure solutions comply with enterprise data governance, privacy, security, audit, and responsible AI requirements. **Job Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience. * 4\+ years of relevant experience in machine learning engineering, applied data science, data engineering, or software engineering for production ML systems. * Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, including experience building maintainable, testable production code. * Hands\-on experience developing, deploying, and supporting machine learning models in production environments. * Experience with cloud platforms, with a preference for Microsoft Azure. * Experience with Apache Spark or Databricks and large\-scale data processing. * Knowledge of supervised learning, forecasting, optimization, feature engineering, model evaluation, and experiment design. * Experience with software engineering practices including Git, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, configuration management, and environment promotion. * Strong problem\-solving, critical\-thinking, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills. * Ability to work independently, manage changing priorities, and deliver in a fast\-paced product environment. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience designing batch and real\-time model\-serving patterns and integrating model outputs into operational applications. * Experience with model explainability techniques, statistical equivalence testing, A/B testing, and business\-impact measurement. * Experience with Azure services such as Synapse Analytics, Event Hubs, Azure Data Lake Storage, or related integration services. * Experience with distributed ML libraries and frameworks such as scikit\-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Spark MLlib. * Experience implementing governed feature stores, lineage, access controls, audit trails, and model approval workflows. **What We Offer You:** * Highly competitive compensation plan. * Salary range $155,000 \- 180,000 annually determined by a myriad of factors including, but not limited to, years of experience, depth of experience, and other relevant business considerations. * Employees are eligible for annual discretionary bonus. * 401(k) plan with company match. * Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) Viking full\-time regular employees working in the United States can purchase Viking shares through payroll deductions. * Full benefits including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance at a highly subsidized rate (some plans are fully paid by Viking). * Accrue 15 paid vacation days, sick time accrual by state, and 6 paid holidays per year. * Opportunity to take a free and/or discounted cruise. * Highly subsidized gym membership. * Discounts on theatres, theme parks, movie tickets, travel discounts through IATA membership and too many more discounts to name. Viking is a certified Great Place to Work company. This certification is a result of our commitment to excellence, integrity and our teams’ outstanding contributions. **About Viking** Viking (NYSE: VIK) is a global leader in experiential travel with a fleet of more than 100 ships, exploring 21 rivers, five oceans and all seven continents. Designed for curious travelers with interests in science, history, culture and cuisine, Chairman and CEO Torstein Hagen often says Viking offers experiences For The Thinking Person™. Viking has more than 450 awards to its name, including being rated \#1 for Rivers and \#1 for Oceans five years in a row by Condé Nast Traveler in the 2025 Readers’ Choice Awards. Viking is also rated a “World’s Best” by Travel \+ Leisure—no other travel company has simultaneously received such honors by both publications.

jobs.title: Co-op: Engineering, Data Science (Spring 2027)
jobs.description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next\-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. **Who We Are** -------------- The Complete Vehicle Features, Analysis, and Simulation Team resides within the Complete Vehicle (CV) organization at Volvo Group North America. Our mission is to be the Voice of the Customer and to build confidence that our products work for our customers through comprehensive verification and validation. CV‑FAST brings together feature ownership, engineering analysis, simulation, and data science to ensure vehicle features are robust, balanced, and verified and validated with the right methods at the right time. The team owns complete vehicle‑level feature performance, leveraging simulation, analytical data, physical testing, and digital verification strategies to front‑load learning, reduce late‑stage risk, and improve customer uptime. CV‑FAST works closely with Engineering, Test, Product Planning, Product Management, and Brands to enable data‑driven decisions across the full product lifecycle. Together with us, you will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals. We have a strong culture based on our company values, which are central to our work. **We believe in a work environment where:** * We constantly strive for outstanding Performance. * We are obsessed with Customer Success. * We initiate Change to stay ahead. * We willingly place our Trust in each other. * We have a huge Passion for what we do. **What You will be doing** -------------------------- At Volvo Group, you will contribute to the transformation of our company, the transport industry, and society at large. As a Data Science Co‑op within the CV‑FAST (Complete Vehicle Features, Analysis \& Simulation) team, you will help turn complex vehicle and engineering data into actionable insights that support data‑driven development across the product lifecycle. You will work with data generated from simulations, testing activities, and connected vehicles to support analysis, modeling, and decision‑making that improves product performance, efficiency, and customer value. Working closely with engineers in Analysis \& Simulation, Feature Engineering, Testing, and Digital teams, you will contribute to building data pipelines, developing analytics and machine learning solutions, and enabling modern, digital workflows. You will support efforts to improve how we analyze, visualize, and leverage data—helping accelerate the shift toward simulation‑driven and data‑driven development practices across Complete Vehicle. **Responsibilities:** * Work with engineers and data scientists to analyze simulation, test, and vehicle data to identify trends, anomalies, and improvement opportunities * Clean, transform, and structure raw datasets to make them usable for analysis and modeling * Develop and maintain data pipelines, scripts, and notebooks to automate repetitive analysis tasks * Create dashboards and visualizations to communicate key insights to engineering teams and stakeholders * Use AI\-assisted tools to accelerate data exploration, generate code, and improve productivity * Support the validation of data and models to ensure accuracy, robustness, and reproducibility * Participate in team standups, technical discussions, and cross\-functional collaboration to align on priorities and deliverables * Build predictive models using vehicle and test data to identify potential performance issues or trends * Develop AI\-assisted tools or workflows (e.g., automated reports, insight generation, or data analysis pipelines) to improve engineering efficiency * Analyze data from vehicle simulations and physical testing to support correlation and improve product validation strategies * Support the development of digital twin or simulation\-driven analytics capabilities by ensuring high\-quality, structured data inputs * Create or enhance Power BI or Streamlit applications that enable engineers to explore and interact with data more effectively * Contribute to projects that automate or modernize engineering processes, reducing manual work and improving consistency * Experiment with machine learning or generative AI techniques to improve how insights are generated and communicated * Impact you will have: * Help improve the speed and quality of engineering decisions through better data and insights * Enable more efficient verification \& validation processes through data\-driven approaches * Contribute to Volvo’s broader digitalization and AI transformation within product development **Who You Are** --------------- You are a motivated and curious student with a strong interest in data science, analytics, and emerging AI technologies. You have a customer‑focused mindset and are eager to apply your technical skills to so am in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field * Applicants must have a minimum cumulative grade point average of 2\.75 * Co\-ops are not enrolled in academic courses during their co\-op rotation and may work up to 40 hours per week * Hands‑on experience with programming for data analysis (e.g., Python, SQL) * Basic understanding of statistics, data analysis, and machine learning concepts * Familiarity with AI/ML workflows, including data preparation, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation * Exposure to Generative AI or AI\-assisted tools (e.g., using AI for coding, analysis, or automation) * Experience working with datasets (cleaning, structuring, analyzing data) * Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to communicate findings clearly * Ability to validate outputs and ensure data quality, accuracy, and reproducibility * Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and learn in a fast‑paced setting **Preferrred:** * Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, matplotlib, plotly) * Exposure to machine learning libraries (e.g., scikit‑learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch) * Familiarity with modern AI concepts (e.g., prompt engineering, embeddings, or retrieval‑based approaches) * Experience building AI\-assisted workflows or lightweight tools (automation scripts, dashboards, or applications) * Familiarity with data pipelines, automation, or scripting workflows * Experience working with engineering, simulation, or test data * Interest in automotive, transportation, or heavy‑duty vehicle systems * Exposure to cloud platforms, databases, or big data tools * Experience contributing to projects involving AI, analytics, automation, or dashboards At the Volvo Group, we strive for a clear, transparent, and straightforward compensation approach, motivating you to contribute to the company’s growth. For all intern and co\-op positions, the hourly range is set at $17\.00 \- $46\.00\. The hourly rate for these roles is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, academic classification, and degree seeking area of study. In addition to these factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as part of any final offer. We also offer the following benefits to interns and co\-ops:* Housing assistance, when applicable * Countless career opportunities / internal mobility across our global organization * Training and personal development All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. **Who we are and what we believe in** We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities. Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. **Trucks Technology \& Industrial Division** hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need. Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **Role Overview** We are seeking a **Full Stack Developer** to design, build, and maintain web applications that power key components of our platform — including data dashboards, secure portals, relational databases, and responsive user interfaces. This role works closely with cross\-functional teams (product, design, operations, and clinical project leads) to deliver high\-impact solutions that improve access to healthcare services for students and families. ***This position is a Hybrid role, between our office in Corona and remotely.*** ***Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.*** **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, and deploy full\-stack web applications using PHP, JavaScript (and related frameworks), HTML, CSS, and SQL. * Build clean, maintainable, and efficient APIs and backend services. * Implement responsive, accessible front\-end features that enhance user experience across devices. * Integrate with 3rd\-party services and internal systems (e.g., payment systems, EHR/medical integration, authentication providers). * Participate in technical architecture reviews and recommend best practices for performance, security, and scalability. * Write unit and integration tests; collaborate in code reviews. * Troubleshoot and resolve software defects and production issues. * Document solutions, technical decisions, and application workflows. * Partner with product owners to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions. **Required Qualifications** * **PHP** (e.g., Zend, W3Schools, or vendor\-specific) * **JavaScript** (such as a recognized JS certification/credential) * **HTML/CSS** (front\-end or web development certifications) * **SQL / Database Development** (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, MySQL University) * Strong experience with **modern full\-stack development** using open\-source and RESTful principles. * Solid understanding of relational database design and SQL query optimization. * Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) and CI/CD workflows. * Experience with responsive web design and cross\-browser compatibility. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to performance and security. * Effective verbal and written communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue, or Angular). * Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. * Familiarity with healthcare data standards or security (HIPAA\-aligned development practices). * Experience in Agile/Scrum working environments.

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Today, when you go to your doctor and get referred to a specialist, your doctor sends out a referral and tells you, “They’ll be in touch soon.” So you wait. And wait. Sometimes days, weeks, or even months. Why? Because too often providers are overwhelmed with the painstakingly tedious work required to get paid by insurance companies. Powered by proprietary models, Tennr handles the complex paperwork that gets patients through the door and providers paid, helping operators get patients the right care, at the right time, in the right setting. **Role Description** You’ll be the senior builder on Tennr’s Infrastructure team, owning the cloud, clusters, and environments that everything else runs on. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role: you’ll help design our Kubernetes foundation, run dev, staging, and production end to end, and keep our AWS footprint clean, secure, and reliable as we scale. We’re looking for someone who executes fast but doesn’t just take orders. The patterns you set and the guardrails you establish are the ones the rest of engineering will inherit. **Responsibilities** * Help build out our EKS cluster module and the patterns other teams inherit from it. * Own cluster management and the dev, staging, and production build\-out end to end. * Drive and unblock infrastructure migrations, keeping them safe, staged, and low\-drama. * Lead the consolidation of our infrastructure observability onto Datadog and set the standards other teams build on. * Own AWS building and maintenance \- networking, IAM, and core services as infrastructure\-as\-code. Keeping the environment secure\-by\-default and cost\-aware. **Candidate Qualifications** * 5–8 years in infrastructure, platform, or DevOps engineering, with real ownership of production systems. * Hands\-on depth with Kubernetes (EKS preferred) and Terraform or comparable infrastructure\-as\-code. * Solid AWS fundamentals: networking, IAM, and the core services a modern platform runs on. * Experience with Datadog or a comparable observability stack, and a point of view on what good looks like. * Comfortable executing autonomously * A pragmatic bias toward simple, durable systems, and toward shipping over gold\-plating * Bonus: experience in a regulated or healthcare (HIPAA / PHI) environment. **Why Tennr?** * **Drive Impact:** one of our company values is Cowboy, meaning you set the pace. You won’t just talk about things, you’ll get them done. And feel the impact. * **Develop Operational Expertise:** learn the inner workings of scaling systems, tools, and infrastructure. * **Innovate with Purpose:** we’re not just doing this for fun (although we do have a lot of fun). At Tennr, you’ll join a high\-caliber team maniacally focused on reducing patient delays across the U.S. healthcare system. * **Build Relationships:** collaborate and connect with like\-minded, driven individuals in our Hudson Square office 4 days/week. * **Free lunch!** Plus a pantry full of snacks. **Benefits** * Beautiful new office at 345 Hudson Street * Unlimited PTO * 100% paid employee health benefit options * Employer\-funded 401(k) match * Competitive parental leave Compensation Range: $200K \- $230K
